copy.tagline: 在无服务器GPU平台上部署AI模型推理端点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速部署AI模型为可调用的API端点
copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI model inference endpoints on a serverless GPU platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly deploy AI models as callable API endpoints

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 Python 定义 GPU 函数，自动部署为 HTTP 接口或定时任务，供 TypeScript 应用调用。
howto.when: 当你需要部署 AI 模型（如 vLLM、Hugging Face）到无服务器 GPU，或创建供 TypeScript 调用的 HTTP API 时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Modal 函数，用 A10G GPU 部署文本生成模型。
用 TypeScript 调用刚才部署的 Modal 端点。
给这个 Modal 端点加上代理认证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you define Python functions with GPU decorators, automatically deploy them as HTTP endpoints or scheduled tasks, and generate TypeScript client code to call them.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to deploy AI models (e.g., vLLM, Hugging Face) on serverless GPUs, or create HTTP APIs for TypeScript apps to consume.

say_en.text: Write a Modal function that uses an A10G GPU to deploy a text generation model.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Python code defining the GPU function and FastAPI endpoint.

say_en.text: Call the deployed Modal endpoint from TypeScript.
say_en.note: Claude will generate fetch code with timeout and error handling.

say_en.text: Add proxy authentication to this Modal endpoint.
